description:
On episode eleven of the Trial of Russell Brand podcast our reporters were in the courtroom as evidence was heard from a former assistant of the comedian. In a statement, Helen Berger remembered him having an “insane sexual appetite” but didn’t remember witnessing Brand doing anything illegal. The court heard that she had worked with lots of celebrities around whom bad behaviour was normalised. “This was on another level”.

The court also heard that the sister of Woman 3 was told Russell Brand’s eyes had become completely blank, like he was “possessed”, when he allegedly assaulted Woman 3 at a birthday party in 2004.

Russell Brand denies all the allegations against him.

Rosamund Urwin and Charlotte Wace are in court every day, and then join Luke Jones to unpack it all.

Watch or listen to The Trial of Russell Brand every weekday on Apple Podcasts, YouTube or listen on Spotify. Follow the show to never miss an episode.

Send us your questions: investigates.podcasts@thetimes.com
